title: Jungle dendrarium
description: Giant procedurally generated structure with traps & loot
body:
## THE JUNGLE DENDRARIUM
*like jungle temple and ancient city with traps and rare cool loot
### add to jungles more fun
exlore the ruins of castle like place with flowers

Three layers of dendrarium

Command to find - /locate gen:main
